    AI Overview
    Paris Saint-Germain defeated Liverpool 4-0 on aggregate in the 2025/26 UEFA Champions League quarterfinals, winning 2-0 at Anfield on April 14, 2026, following a 2-0 first-leg victory in Paris. Ousmane Dembélé scored both goals in the second leg (72', 90+1') to seal PSG's semifinal spot. 
    Key Match Stats (2nd Leg at Anfield): 
    • Final Score: Liverpool 0-2 PSG (Agg: 0-4)
    • Possession: Liverpool 53% | PSG 47%
    • Total Shots: Liverpool 21 | PSG 12
    • Shots on Target: Liverpool 5 | PSG 6
    • Expected Goals (xG): Liverpool 1.92 | PSG 1.25
    • Attendance: 59,627 
    Match Details: 
    • Goalscorers: Ousmane Dembélé (72', 90+1')
    • Assists: Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, Bradley Barcola
    • Key Action: Giorgi Mamardashvili made 6 saves, while PSG's defense (Marquinhos) blocked a crucial Virgil van Dijk effort to maintain their lead. 
    PSG advanced to their third consecutive Champions League semi-final.
